outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum for PacL1, a representative measurement without averaged/error-bar statistics, so replicate reporting is not required.
Panel B is a single representative native MS spectrum for PacL1Δ5, with no quantification or statistics requiring replicate information.

Panel C is a quantified bar chart of metal-bound protein fractions (from native MS) but the caption gives no n-number or replicate type (e.g., number of independent MS measurements) underlying these proportions.
Panel D presents quantified bar-chart data on zinc-bound species fractions with no stated number or type of replicate measurements.
Panel E shows quantified bar-chart proportions of copper-bound species without any indication of replicate number or type.
Panel F displays quantified bar-chart proportions of manganese-bound species with no replicate number or type reported in the caption.
Panel G is a quantified bar chart of chemical shift perturbations across residues at multiple zinc equivalents, but no replicate number or type (e.g., number of independent NMR titrations) is stated.
Panel H is a quantified bar chart of chemical shift perturbations across residues at multiple cadmium equivalents, with no replicate number or type reported.
